title: Figure 18: Single pulse maximum permissible exposure (corneal exposure vs time)
description: Log-log plot of Corneal Exposure (Joules/cm²) from 10^-6 to 10^3 versus Time (seconds) from 10^-15 to 10^3, with stepped threshold lines for wavelength bands including 400-700 nm, 400-450 nm, 475 nm, 500-700 nm, 1.05-1.15 µm and 1.2-1.4 µm. Data points are marked as triangles for Visible and gray dots for Near IR. Caption reads "Figure 18. Single Pulse Maximum Permissible Exposure."
